brief: Thanksgiving posts dominated today's feed, with many builders sharing personal holiday messages. The most notable beyond that were Amjad Masad's note on Google's Gemini 4 on Replit and Thibault Sottiaux's brief Codex-related post, plus Aaron Levie on agent-centered services firms.

themes.label: Gemini 4 on Replit
themes.summary: Amjad Masad said Google's Gemini 4 is strong and pointed readers to try it on Replit.

themes.label: Agents in services firms
themes.summary: Aaron Levie argued agents let services firms deliver projects with a 10X multiplier and reach smaller clients.

builders.name: Latent Space
builders.summary: Published a podcast with Thariq Shihipar of OpenAI, recorded at the AIE Code Summit, on his thinking about building with agents and whether models should improve themselves headlessly.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Said Google really cooked with Gemini 4 and invited readers to try it on Replit.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary: Argued agents create a big opportunity to build or transform services firms in advertising, IT, consulting and finance, with domain expertise still essential.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Noted an early win over Cursor and t3code on day 0, and argued agentic payments is a divisive theme for 2028. Also shared tips on refounding in public.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Mostly personal and minor posts about Trump accounts, a SpaceX share for kids, and a GTA VI joke.

builders.name: Sam Altman
builders.summary: Praised Ven as an early believer in using OpenAI models to tackle Millennium Prize problems, and posted personal Thanksgiving messages about family.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: Shared 12 tips for moving from LinkedIn to X, based on growing to 80k followers on X in one year.

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.summary: Posted a short quip about VCs getting thanks for thought leadership while no founder is thanked.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Shared a fully local script that helps text people you spent time with, built with Claude by reading local iMessage and WhatsApp databases.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Posted a single short update: the banked reset is online.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Gave a Thanksgiving message on optimism and using agency to build the future.

builders.name: Aditya Agarwal
builders.summary: Posted a short reaction with no substantive content.

builders.name: Nan Yu
builders.summary: Said voice chat, image uploads and instructions that return a site are all available in ChatGPT today.
